cases.category: both local policy and evaluator allow

expected.derivation: Local policy allows and the evaluator result is fresh, bound to the request, and allow, so the intersection is allow. The result remains non-authorizing; the local apply gate still decides execution.

cases.category: local policy permits, external evaluator denies

expected.derivation: Composition is by intersection and deny takes precedence. Local allow cannot override the evaluator deny.

cases.category: local policy denies, external evaluator permits

expected.derivation: Local policy denies, so the intersection is deny regardless of the evaluator allow. The evaluator result never grants authority the local policy withholds.

cases.category: unknown required evaluator profile version

expected.derivation: Unknown required semantics fail profile validation. The controller cannot interpret a profile version it did not negotiate, so the result is rejected rather than read as allow.

cases.category: allow_unresolved with an identified resolver and explicit downstream outcome

expected.derivation: The evaluator is unresolved but names the component responsible for the remaining check, and the downstream outcome is explicit. The composed outcome stays allow_unresolved and is not execution permission.

cases.category: allow_unresolved without an explicit downstream outcome

expected.derivation: The evaluator names a resolver but the composed call has no explicit downstream outcome, so the unresolved obligation would become permission by default. It is rejected instead.

cases.category: stale or expired evaluator result

expected.derivation: The result expired before the evaluation time. Freshness is part of the binding, so a stale allow is rejected.

cases.category: result bound to a different action, target, audience, domain or policy generation

expected.derivation: The controller derives the projection from its own request; the carried projection names a different target, so the digest the controller expects does not match.

cases.category: unsupported optional extension that is safely ignored

expected.derivation: The only ununderstood extension is declared OPTIONAL_IGNORABLE, so it may be ignored. A REQUIRED_* extension with the same id would be a rejection.

cases.category: evidence preservation showing which decision and freshness inputs supported the outcome

expected.derivation: The composed outcome preserves the evaluator evidence references. Management records the decision and freshness inputs without importing raw credentials or unrestricted policy content.

cases.category: local policy is unresolved, evaluator permits

expected.derivation: The evaluator result is allow, but the local policy is unresolved. Intersection cannot raise the local decision, so the composed outcome stays allow_unresolved and is not execution permission.

cases.category: result with a verifiable Ed25519 integrity envelope

expected.derivation: The result is bound to the request and fresh, and its Ed25519 signature verifies under the pinned key; the outcome remains allow and non-authorizing.

cases.category: delegated obligation whose resolver cannot determine a status

expected.derivation: A delegated obligation with an unknown resolver status cannot be relied on; the local gate must fail closed.

cases.category: request projection version not accepted

expected.derivation: The controller does not accept projection version 2, so it cannot interpret the binding and refuses.

cases.category: delegated obligation resolved as violated

expected.derivation: A violated delegated obligation denies; it is never an unresolved allow.

cases.category: obligation identity the controller does not recognise

expected.derivation: An obligation identity the controller does not recognise is an unknown parameter identity, not a delegated obligation; it fails validation.

cases.category: deployment requires integrity but the result carries none

expected.derivation: The deployment requires a verifiable integrity envelope; a result without one is refused.

cases.category: projection carries an authority context the controller did not request

expected.derivation: The controller derives the projection from its own request; an evaluator-added authority context changes the digest it expects, so the result is refused.

cases.category: unknown optional-negotiable extension cannot be silently ignored

expected.derivation: Only OPTIONAL_IGNORABLE may be ignored; an unnegotiated OPTIONAL_NEGOTIABLE extension is refused.

cases.category: the same obligation appears twice in the unresolved list

expected.derivation: A duplicated obligation would be counted twice; the result is refused.

cases.category: named resolver is not the responsible component of the obligation

expected.derivation: The obligation names one resolver and the downstream outcome names another; the binding is inconsistent and refused.

cases.category: evaluator policy digest is not in the controller accepted set

expected.derivation: The controller pins the policy digests it accepts; an unpinned evaluator policy is refused.

cases.category: local decision is not one of the three defined states

expected.derivation: An unrecognised local decision cannot compose; it is refused rather than treated as allow.

cases.category: downstream resolver timed out

expected.derivation: A timed-out resolution fails closed; it is not an unresolved allow.

cases.category: freshness window exceeds the controller maximum

expected.derivation: The controller bounds how long a result may remain valid; a longer window is refused.

cases.category: request digest does not match the controller-derived projection

expected.derivation: The digest is checked against the projection the controller derives from its own request.

cases.category: local unresolved cannot mask a violated evaluator obligation

expected.derivation: Deny and violation take precedence over a local unresolved state.

cases.category: local unresolved cannot skip unknown required semantics

expected.derivation: Unknown required semantics are refused before any composition.

cases.category: result issued after the controller clock

expected.derivation: A result issued in the controller's future is refused.

cases.category: the same extension id appears twice

expected.derivation: Duplicate extension identities are refused instead of double-counted.

cases.category: evaluator identity not in the controller accepted set

expected.derivation: The controller pins evaluator identities; an unknown one is refused.

cases.category: controller has no accepted policy set

expected.derivation: A missing pin set is a refusal, not pinning disabled.

cases.category: evaluator profile id not pinned

expected.derivation: The controller pins the profile identity as well as its version.

cases.category: result with a verifiable Ed25519 integrity envelope

expected.derivation: The Ed25519 signature does not verify.

cases.category: result with a verifiable Ed25519 integrity envelope

expected.derivation: A signature under an unpinned key is refused.

cases.category: result with a verifiable Ed25519 integrity envelope

expected.derivation: Changing the decision changes the canonical bytes.

cases.category: intent digest does not match the request body

expected.derivation: The controller recomputes the intent digest from its own request bytes; a different digest is refused.

cases.category: both local policy and evaluator allow

expected.derivation: An optional extension is ignorable only when the controller profile declares that id.

cases.category: both local policy and evaluator allow

expected.derivation: An allow must carry at least one evidence reference.

cases.category: allow_unresolved with an identified resolver and explicit downstream outcome

expected.derivation: An unsupported resolution fails closed, distinctly from a timeout.

cases.category: both local policy and evaluator allow

expected.derivation: A required parameter identity the controller does not know is refused.

cases.category: both local policy and evaluator allow

expected.derivation: The result names a controller different from the negotiated requirement.

cases.category: both local policy and evaluator allow

expected.derivation: The controller pins the requirement digest; an unpinned one is refused.
